fusions.name: Powder Burst
fusions.desc: Fires a blast of shot through the tines, dealing 14 damage to everything within 4 tiles in front of you and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sudden Report
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Long Bore
fusions.desc: For 30 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Smoke Trail
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a shot flies to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
